title: Boiling Water Turns Into Snow in Freezing Air

scenes.text: Boiling water turns to snow in freezing air.
At around minus twenty-two degrees Fahrenheit, or colder, it works.
The water breaks into tiny droplets in the air.
Boiling water gives off lots of vapor. Cold air can't hold much of it.
So the vapor freezes onto dust in the air, the way snowflakes form.
Boiling water in, snow out. Watch it again.

description:
Throw boiling water into very cold air, around minus 22 degrees Fahrenheit or colder, and it can turn into ice crystals instantly.
Cold air can hold very little vapor, so the vapor freezes onto particles like snowflakes do.
Have you seen it in person?
